_comment: Worked example (the Solenne Beauty '5-Step Glassy Matte Routine' build). Creative fields — assets.creator_anchor + assets._note_creator + scene_clips.clips[].beat (choices.creator), assets.vanity_world (choices.setting), vo.voice_id + vo.voice_name + vo.source (choices.voice), vo.script + vo.style (choices.tone), music.prompt (choices.music) — come from the recipe's choices; never copy them as defaults. palette + products + cards come from the brand kit / PDPs, not this file. Copy to config.json and edit. A ~32s 9:16 (1080x1920, 30fps) MULTI-SCENE GRWM beauty demo where a locked-identity creator applies 5 Solenne products step-by-step at a sage vanity, a SEPARATE locked ElevenLabs Karri VO narrates the routine, and every scene cut is snapped to the VO's 'step N' / product-name word-starts (Whisper), with 5 Playwright product overlay cards (real PDP taglines) on the product-name beats, a warm acoustic music bed ducked under the VO, clean-white 3-words/cue captions, closing on a gpt-image-2 flat-lay end card. Pipeline: (1) lock creator anchor + sage-vanity world + hook keyframe + Karri VO (atempo 1.15x -> ~27.5s); (2) 7 Seedance 2.0 scene clips (720p, --no-audio) + the flat-lay still; (3) Groq whisper-large-v3 word-level on the VO; (4) re-cut + hard-concat to the 12 VO cuts (build_v4.py, -crf 20 re-encode); (5) 5 white-bg gpt-image-2 product cutouts (PDP-verified taglines) + Playwright cards (render_cards.py); (6) composite cards on the product-name beats (composite_cards.py, -loop 1 -t) + mix VO/music + burn captions + flat-lay end card (build_master.py). Master 1080x1920 h264+aac, ~32s. See scripts/PIPELINE.md for the source scripts.
title: 5 products, one finish

assets._note_creator: EXAMPLE ONLY (set from choices.creator + choices.setting). Demo creator: 26yo brunette w/ caramel highlights, black satin headband, white ribbed tank, in a sage-green bathroom. Identity + wardrobe + setting held across every scene clip.
assets._note_hook: Creator holding the ~5 products fanned near the face (demo: 5 pink Solenne barrels). Doubles as the payoff-smile beat (s07a).

vo._comment: SEPARATE locked ElevenLabs VO (voice from choices.voice, delivery from choices.tone; the demo used Karri) — NOT a native Seedance take. Whispered FIRST; the word-starts set the timeline. atempo 1.15x makes it end at ~27.5s (NOT 45s). Script written clean (no eleven_v3 audio tags).
vo.script: okay, my five-step glassy matte routine. step one, Halo Perfector. it's basically skincare you put on first. step two, Dune Duo. blush and bronzer in one stick. step three, Glow Trip for contour. step four, Halo Powder. it brightens and blurs. step five, Setting Mist. that's the lock. five products, one finish. about three minutes.

_word_starts._comment: Whisper-verified word-starts for this exact atempo'd mp3. Scene cuts snap to the 'step N' starts; cards snap to the product-NAME starts.

scene_clips._beat_rule: beat = THIS brand's product N applied by the creator from choices.creator (soft verbs: dabs / swirls / dusts). The beats below are the Solenne demo's.
scene_clips._comment: 7 Seedance 2.0 clips (create-video-seedance-fal, Fal direct, 720p, 9:16, --no-audio) off the locked anchor + world. Softer verbs — s05 powder used 'swirls'/'dusts' after a 422 on 'press'/'brush her face'. All 7 are paid calls.

clips.beat: holds five glossy pink Solenne cream-sticks fanned near her face, eye contact with selfie camera, playful smile
dabs a few pearls of pink Halo Perfector onto cheekbones + forehead with fingertips, taps them in
swipes the Dune Duo cream-stick on cheeks/nose/forehead, presses in with a dense face brush
stripes the Glow Trip contour stick along cheekbone hollow + jawline, blends down with fingertips
swirls a soft brush in the pink compact, taps it, dusts across her T-zone (softer verbs — 'press'/'brush her face' 422'd)
holds the Halo Setting Mist ~8in from her face and sprays a fine even mist; skin gains a glassy glow
smiles fully into the selfie camera, fresh glassy-matte makeup on, warm confident expression

cuts._comment: 12 cuts derived from the VO word-starts (build_v4.py). Scene cuts land on 'step N' starts; s02 + s03 + s05 sub-cut for pacing. Hard-concat, re-encode -c:v libx264 -crf 20. cuts/10s = 12/32*10 = 3.75.

windows.why: perfector second half — ends as 'Dune Duo' begins
Dune Duo continuation — ends as 'step three' begins
powder application — ends as 'step five' begins
mist — ends as 'five products' payoff begins
payoff smile during 'five products, one finish'
end-card ken-burns on the flat-lay still

products._comment: 5 white-bg standalone gpt-image-2 cutouts (gen-product-cutouts.sh). Taglines VERIFIED against solennebeauty.example PDPs — the gpt-image-2 flat-lay renders WRONG sublines ('SCULPT + GLOW' on Dune Duo, 'BLUSH + HIGHLIGHT' on GlowTrip). Halo Perfector is a slim liquid bottle, NOT a wide cream stick (even though the Seedance s02 clip shows a wide barrel — the card shows the REAL product).
products._note_taglines: Taglines above are the card lines used in the worked example; ALWAYS re-verify against the live PDP before shipping a new brand — do not carry these forward.

cards._comment: 5 Playwright cards from working/product-card.html.tmpl at 2x scale (render_cards.py): palette.card_bg card + palette.accent bar from the brand kit (demo: warm cream #F8EEDE + pink #E879A6) + cutout thumb + Georgia name + uppercase pink tagline. Composited (composite_cards.py) snapped to the product-NAME word-start (~1s after the scene cut), 1s fade-in. PNG overlays NEED -loop 1 -t <dur>.

music._comment: Instrumental bed from choices.music — prompt below is the demo's warm acoustic pick; skip the bed if the user chose none (ElevenLabs Music, 45s — only ~32s consumed), ducked under the VO. No artist names in the prompt (ElevenLabs ToS filter).
music.prompt: Warm acoustic instrumental, soft nylon guitar + light percussion, gentle and aspirational, easygoing morning-routine energy, no vocals.

audio_mix._comment: The SEPARATE VO is the lead; the music sits well under it. loudnorm I=-14.

captions._comment: Clean-white captions from the VO's Whisper words. OVERRIDE the clean-white preset: 3 words/cue, 3.0% font, 20% from the bottom, NO pill, NO shadow (default 5-words/4.5%/18% is too dense). Built in cue_builder.py within build_master.py.

end_card._comment: gpt-image-2 9:16 flat-lay still of the 5 products on cream linen, ken-burns held ~4.2s at the tail (27.80 -> 32.00). Do NOT trust the flat-lay's AI sublines for taglines — PDP-verify (see products[]).

vo.note: the SEPARATE locked ElevenLabs VO (atempo 1.15x) narrates the routine and drives every cut

product_cards.note: 5 Playwright cards (real cutout + PDP tagline), each on its product-NAME word-start

music.note: warm instrumental bed ducked under the VO, loudnorm I=-14

captions.note: clean-white, 3 words/cue, 3.0% font, 20% margin, no pill/shadow

end_card.note: gpt-image-2 flat-lay still of the 5 products, ken-burns held ~4s
